capabilities: Toggle canvas notes between embedded view and compact card view
Rename notes or headings in place on the canvas
Open a note as an editable document in a modal
Create new notes directly on the canvas via toolbox button or context menu
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; it displays canvas notes as small title cards.
extras: Relies on undocumented Obsidian internals because Canvas has no official plugin API, so Obsidian updates may break it; the README asks users to report breakage via issues.
intentEvidence: Show notes on a canvas as compact title cards instead of full embedded documents.
problem: Obsidian Canvas embeds notes as full documents, which takes up space and makes large canvases hard to scan.
summary: Canvas plugin that renders markdown notes as compact title cards with in-place renaming, modal editing, and note creation on the canvas.
